title: Dual Ended Eyeshadow Brush
descriptionHtml:
What it is: A dual-ended eyeshadow brush with two fluffy ends that seamlessly blend crème and powder formulas.

Brush Formulation: Cream and Powder

Ingredient Callouts: It is vegan and cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: The small, fluffy brush head is designed for crème and powder formulas, providing targeted blending and high-impact payoff. The larger side diffuses powders all over the lids for smooth transitions and definition. Made with PATRICK TA’s signature patented fibers for soft, seamless blending.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
Small Rounded Brush:
-Use the smaller domed side to apply both crème and powder formulas with precise control and high-impact payoff. It's made to reach even the smallest areas of the eyes, like the inner corners and along the lash line.

Large Rounded Brush:
-Use the larger domed side to apply powder eyeshadow all over the lids with no harsh lines. Create smooth transitions, and soft, effortless definition with every layer.
